lines.l: Five days on the freeway, riding shotgun with you
Two hearts in the fast lane, we had big dreams in blue
Playing street, child of mine, and I still feel that line
Where are you now? Where are you now?
Hey, it's been too long, too long ago, my love
Where did we go wrong? Too late to turn around
Where are you now? Where are you now?
You're just like my favorite song going round, round my head
But the feeling ain't all blue
One day you gotta come through
You're just like my favorite sun
You're just like my favorite sun
